duties.SUPER_ADMIN: Platform owner: not a member of any Saving Scheme. Create groups, appoint Presidents, see every Saving Scheme, and take full control when officers need help.
duties.MEMBER: Save each month, request loans, and view your own fines, social fund, and share-out.
duties.PRESIDENT: Chair the group, settle disputes, suspend members, approve rule changes, and co-sign money leaving the fund.
duties.VICE_PRESIDENT: Act for the President when they are away, with the same authority, and head the loan committee.
duties.SECRETARY: Keep the membership register and the record of meetings and decisions. This is not a money role.
duties.ACCOUNTANT: Record contributions, loan disbursements, and repayments, and prepare share-out figures. A President must co-sign money movements.
duties.LOAN_OFFICER: Review loan requests against savings history, approve or reject them, then send approved loans to the Accountant to disburse.
duties.COOPERATIVE_ADMIN: Chair the group, settle disputes, suspend members, approve rule changes, and co-sign money leaving the fund.
